summary: POSCO Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 7, 2026, announcing the record date for its second-quarter 2026 dividend. The record date is August 24, 2026 (Seoul Time). The filing designates the date to finalize the list of shareholders eligible to receive the quarterly dividend, pursuant to Article 56-2 of the company's Articles of Incorporation. This routine announcement is a capital-return event, as the dividend distribution represents a return of capital to shareholders. No other deal terms such as price per share or premium are specified.
